dbo.name: conversation
dbo.description: A single chat thread. Owned by a user (authenticated) and/or reachable with a session token (guest).

schema.name: user_id
schema.description: The user this conversation belongs to. Null until a guest thread is claimed.

schema.name: session_token
schema.description: Opaque bearer capability for guest access to this thread. Treat it like a password.

schema.name: title
schema.description: Human-readable thread title. Seeded from the first user message.

schema.name: last_message_at
schema.description: When the most recent message was appended. Null until the first send.

dbo.name: conversation_message
dbo.description: One turn in a conversation. Replayed to the agent as an LLM message.

schema.name: conversation_id
schema.description: The thread this message belongs to.

schema.name: role
schema.description: Who produced this turn. The engine rejects any other value when replaying it.

schema.name: content
schema.description: The message text. Must be non-empty — a blank turn makes the model confabulate.

function.name: chatbot/generate_reply
function.description: Appends a user message, runs the chat agent over recent history, appends the reply, and returns it. Performs no authorization.

input.name: conversation_id
input.description: The thread to append to. NOT authorized here — the caller must have checked ownership.

input.name: content
input.description: The user's message text. Must be non-empty.

error.value: The assistant returned an empty reply. Try again.

query.name: chat/conversations/create
query.description: Create a new conversation owned by the authenticated user

input.name: title
input.description: Optional thread title. Left blank, the first message's opening words become the title.

query.name: chat/conversations
query.description: List the authenticated user's conversations, most recently active first

query.name: chat/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages
query.description: Read a conversation's transcript, oldest message first

query.name: chat/conversations/{conversation_id}/send
query.description: Append a message to the conversation and return the agent's reply

input.name: content
input.description: The user's message. Must be non-empty after trimming.

input.name: error
input.value: Too many messages. Please wait a moment and try again.

error.value: send: non-empty message content must be provided via `content`, `message`, or `prompt`.

query.name: chat/conversations/{conversation_id}
query.description: Delete a conversation and every message in it

query.name: chat/conversations/{conversation_id}/claim
query.description: Attach an unclaimed guest conversation to the authenticated user

input.name: session_token
input.description: The guest session token the thread was created with.

error.value: This conversation has already been claimed.

query.name: chat/guest/conversations/create
query.description: Create an anonymous conversation and return its session token

input.name: title
input.description: Optional thread title. Left blank, the first message's opening words become the title.

input.name: error
input.value: Too many messages. Please wait a moment and try again.

query.name: chat/guest/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages
query.description: Read a guest conversation's transcript, oldest message first

input.name: session_token
input.description: The token returned when the conversation was created.

error.value: This conversation now belongs to an account. Sign in to continue it.

query.name: chat/guest/conversations/{conversation_id}/send
query.description: Append a message to a guest conversation and return the agent's reply

input.name: content
input.description: The user's message. Must be non-empty after trimming.

input.name: error
input.value: Too many messages. Please wait a moment and try again.

error.value: This conversation now belongs to an account. Sign in to continue it.
send: non-empty message content must be provided via `content`, `message`, or `prompt`.

query.name: chat/guest/conversations/{conversation_id}/delete
query.description: Delete a guest conversation and every message in it

error.value: This conversation now belongs to an account. Sign in to continue it.

toolset.name: chatbot_agent
toolset.description: Conversational assistant. Receives the thread's recent turns as decoded LLM messages and returns the next one.

app.name: Chatbot
app.description: Conversational AI endpoints: create and list conversations, read a transcript, and send a message to the agent.
